summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new 'share by page/model' admin flow in Cartazista Pro. All 6 scenarios in the review request pass. Admin login works; admin panel shows a single page thumbnail (renderPageThumb) reflecting the current layout (grid-4 → 2 cols, grid-1 → 1 col); the old per-cartaz checkboxes (.admin-cartaz-chk) are gone (0 found); 'Modelos de cada usuário' lists 1 entry per user (2 users found: loja1@gestor.com and oficialsnts@gmail.com (você)) each with a .page-thumb, share and clone buttons; clone action triggers success toast; sending page does not crash the app and button returns to normal state. No unhandled JS errors triggered by the new flow.
action_items: (Expected/informational) Deploy /app/firestore.rules so that shares/setDoc, collectionGroup('cartazes') and users/{uid}/data/session reads for admin work in production. Currently the 'Enviar esta página' write may fail with permission-denied — the UI handles it gracefully but the feature only fully works after rules deploy.
(Pre-existing, expected) Console shows 'auth/admin-restricted-operation' on initial signInAnonymously — anonymous auth is disabled in the Firebase project, as documented in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: app.js is 2705 lines — consider splitting into modules (admin panel, editor, share/inbox, firebase-init) for maintainability.
adminClonarModelo silently swaps state.layout to the cloned model's layout — could surprise the admin if they just wanted to append cartazes; consider prompting or keeping current layout.

renderPageThumb caps at PER_PAGE[layout] cartazes, so if the user has more than 4 cartazes on a grid-4 page the thumbnail only shows the first page — acceptable for a preview, but a small badge like '+N mais' would be a nice touch.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing data (4 cartazes already on admin page; 1 other user 'loja1@gestor.com' already in Firestore).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The share-by-page/model refactor is fully working on the frontend side. Verified: renderPageThumb respects layout (grid-1/2/4), admin-cartaz-list has NO per-cartaz checkboxes (assert .admin-cartaz-chk count == 0), admin-all-list has 1 row per user with .page-thumb + Compartilhar + clone buttons, clone toast 'Modelo clonado para a sua página.' appears. The only remaining piece is the Firestore rules deploy by the user for the actual 'shares' write to succeed.
